-- Lua の見本
--[[ 複数行の
コメント ]]
local json = require("json")
local M = {}
M.__index = M

local DEFAULTS <const> = { size = 10, name = "box", [1] = true }

function M.new(opts)
  local self = setmetatable({}, M)
  opts = opts or {}
  self.size = opts.size or DEFAULTS.size
  self.items = {}
  return self
end

function M:push(...)
  for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
    local v = select(i, ...)
    if type(v) == "table" and #v > 0 then
      table.insert(self.items, v)
    elseif v ~= nil then
      self.items[#self.items + 1] = { v }
    end
  end
  return self
end

local function fib(n)
  if n < 2 then return n end
  return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
end

for k, v in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
  print(string.format("%s = %q", tostring(k), tostring(v)))
end

local s = [[long
string]] .. [==[with ]] inside]==]
local n = 0x1F + 1.5e-3 + 10 // 3 + 2 ^ 8
while n > 0 do n = n - 1 end
repeat n = n + 1 until n >= 3
goto done
::done::
print(fib(10), s, n, json.encode(M.new():push(1, "two", { 3 }).items))
return M
local broken = "閉じない文字列
